question: Do version-bound development evidence and compatible path selection improve complete artifacts under explicit resource budgets?
task_design: 8 cleanup policies x 2 row counts x 2 quoting conditions x 2 threshold conditions = 64 derived tasks per dataset
task_semantics: parse CSV; deduplicate by sample_id keeping first if requested; remove all cross-split subjects if requested; drop exactly empty score if requested; compute binary counts and metrics at score >= 0.5
network: 18 locally authored versioned operators: 3 variants for each of parser/dedup/exclude/drop/metrics/composite
evidence: independent artifact probes on development datasets only; complete implementation resource hash must match, including identical aliases
probability: (successes+1)/(attempts+2), ranking heuristic only, not a calibrated guarantee
ablation_without_version: deliberately use node ID without matching implementation hash; chiefly evaluated under version drift
metadata_sensitivity: three additional opaque-ID permutations on main tasks at 1.5x budget for metadata, MMR, global risk and conditional evidence; same inputs not new independent tasks
budget_anchor: minimum metadata-only feasible path bytes; no outcome-dependent budget choice
cost_unit: UTF-8 bytes of versioned operator context and actual operator invocations; not token prices or currency
path_objective: sum(-log(development posterior predictive success)) + 0.05 * selected_context_bytes/budget + 0.02 * operator_count; discard context groups with observed development failures
primary: all independently required rows and metrics correct, counting abstentions as no solved artifact
primary_estimand: mean success over the three fixed budgets per held-out task, then equal-weight datasets; 128 tasks, not 384 independent cases
primary_comparison: conditional_evidence_path minus metadata_shortest_path; all stronger/simple baselines reported
comparison_rule: all methods share the same candidates, task intent, budgets, executor and final verifier
statistics: paired conditional bootstrap over 32 constructed policy/quote/threshold blocks; show each held-out dataset; no population significance or calibration claim
repeats: permutation and container reproductions are sensitivity checks, not additional independent inputs
strong_control: project native symbolic shortest-path planner; manual fixed correct workflow; simple quality-filter-plus-path baseline
community_network: any 1881-library shadow replay stays separate from executable controlled-network claims
limits: 18 owned operators rather than 1881 natural community Skills
no claim of algorithmic novelty or general superiority
